name: pr-metadata
title: PR metadata
description: Every 3 hours (worker on Claude Sonnet): labels, assignee, review request, milestone and project board status on every open pull request; one comment and one notification when a pull request is ready for the maintainer.
notes: Optional: the project board step needs the app's organisation permission Projects (read and write) and a 'Project board:' line in PROFILE.md, Labels; without them it is skipped and reported. Telegram (bin/notify) is optional too: without it only the PushNotification is sent.
